summary: Enhance your skills in financial management for donor-funded projects. Join our training to learn effective budgeting, reporting, and compliance strategies.
lede: Financial management of donor-funded projects links grant budgets, transactions, controls, and financial reporting. For project accountants, finance officers, grants managers, and project directors, this training addresses the practical work of tracking restricted funds and producing traceable reports. Participants practise budget-to-actual analysis, cash forecasting and reconciliation, and checking expenditure eligibility and supporting documents.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who prepare, review, approve, monitor, or report financial information for grants and other donor-funded projects. It suits foundation to intermediate learners who work with project budgets and financial records but want a more structured control and reporting process.
modules: Donor Finance Foundations and Grant Architecture
COSO Controls and Project Risk Assessment
Budget Control and Excel Variance Analysis
Donor Reporting and Project Finance Roadmaps
prerequisites: Prior experience with basic accounting, budgeting, or project administration is useful but not mandatory. You should be comfortable reading a budget, reviewing invoices, and working with simple spreadsheets. No programming is required. Advanced digital analysis is taught at an operational application level using Excel-based templates and dashboard concepts, not software engineering. Participants should bring a laptop with spreadsheet software if available; software installation and paid licences are not required for the core exercises.
topics: Financial management for NGOs & donor-funded projects
